# fortiappseccloud_waf_template_file_protection

Configures file protection for one FortiAppSec Cloud WAF template using the static template endpoint `/waf/template/{template_id}/file_protection`. This resource owns the template's module settings. To make an application inherit them, configure the matching app module resource with `template = true` and omit its `configs` block.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_file_protection` resource for a WAF template.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_template_file_protection" "example" {
  template_id = fortiappseccloud_waf_template.example.template_id

  configs {
    status            = true
    action            = "alert_deny"
    trojan            = false
    sandbox           = false
    av_scan           = true
    file_action       = "Allow"
    file_size         = 10240
    url               = "/1"
    json_file_support = false

    file_types {
      item {
        type = "GIF"
        tid  = "00001"
      }
    }

    custom_file_types {
      item {
        name           = "custom-archive"
        file_extension = "foo"

        file_content_match_rule {
          item {
            data_value       = "magic-bytes"
            offset_from      = "beginning"
            offset           = 0
            operation        = "equal"
            data_type        = "string"
            concatenate_type = "AND"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Configuration Notes

- When `json_file_support = true`, also set `json_key_field`. Each file type needs a compatible `type` and five-digit `tid`; hexadecimal content values must contain valid, even-length hexadecimal data.

## Argument Reference

- `template_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — WAF template ID.
- `configs` (Required) — Typed file protection configuration. Its attributes and ownership-wrapper blocks are identical to `fortiappseccloud_waf_file_protection` when that app resource uses `template = false`.

## Import

Import using the template ID:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_template_file_protection.example TEMPLATE_ID
```

The first read after import hydrates all supported ownership wrappers.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
